_comment: Copy to snapshots/account_registry.json (already gitignored) and fill in real accounts. Maps a short alias -> {customer_id, name}. Every tool's customer_id parameter accepts either the alias or the raw numeric id transparently (see src/utils.py's format_customer_id). Only works for accounts reachable with this deployment's single set of API credentials (same manager/login_customer_id) - a genuinely separate developer token/OAuth client still needs its own .env/process, see docs/ACCOUNT_SWITCHING.md and docs/CLIENT_ONBOARDING.md.
